reviewer: task_row_storage, separate from the public-pack publisher
review_kind: Independent read-only verification of exported evidence, source identity and reporting claims; not independent repetition of every experiment.
publication_state_at_review: Git blobs were prepared by the parent but the final evidence commit and DELIVERY_MANIFEST were not part of this review. The 44-file repository staging copy matched the reviewed public-pack byte-for-byte.

resolved_review_comments.finding: The 3444/3686 token values in the rotation diagnosis are host input estimates from a scripted-backend fixture, not provider-measured token usage.
resolved_review_comments.correction: RESULTS now explicitly says 第三轮输入的宿主估算. No raw input, archive or numerical result was altered.

public_material_scan.scope: Pattern-only scan of public files and selected archive bytes; no private credential file opened. Exporter known-credential exact-match result was read but not independently repeated.
public_material_scan.result: No API-key/private-key pattern hits in selected public bytes. No private credential was read or printed by this reviewer; this is not a universal proof about arbitrary unknown secret formats.

source_identity.status_note: Root copied the delivery directory into docs/evidence during review; only that new untracked evidence directory is present, tracked source remains identical to the final tested commit.

engineering_results.inference_boundary: Host event excerpt and provider-reported model records checked; provider does not independently echo effort. No private database opened by reviewer.

performance_limitation_review: first host open includes migration plus backup and startup
payload byte count excludes physical SQLite/index/backup footprint
count(*) retained; same-session 10000 privacy walk not measured

packaging_and_frontend.scope: Read-only byte/provenance/log review; did not run business tests, native UI or model APIs.

relative_links.note: DELIVERY_MANIFEST and this review are intentional post-review additions. No hash or approval of the future delivery manifest is claimed.

scope_limits: This pass concerns evidence integrity and accurate reporting. It does not turn the overall release status into RELEASE_READY.
No business tests, benchmarks, native UI or external model/API calls were run during this evidence review. Existing raw results were recomputed and cross-checked read-only.
R11 effort was checked in the published actual host-event excerpt; provider usage independently reports the model but not the reasoning effort. Private SQLite was not opened by this reviewer.
Final Core wheel contents, installed files and tracked source were compared byte-for-byte. This is Python packaging evidence, not native installer/signature/macOS hardware acceptance.
PR merge state, tags/releases and the future final GitHub delivery were not independently queried in this review; the parent owns final publication and readback.
The authoring agent previously implemented storage and ran some raw tests; the independence here is from the evidence publisher and report aggregation, not a separate lab replication of every claim.
reviewer_mutations: Only validation review artifacts written. No product source, public-pack input, archive, benchmark sample or original report was edited by the reviewer.
